entities.name: The Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: A major conflict on Zendikar in 4557-4559 AR against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Battle was fought.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan awakened by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and their spawn who nearly destroyed Zendikar.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who betrayed the defenders and unleashed Kozilek.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Manipulated events leading to the release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Rallied Zendikar's survivors to retake Sea Gate.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: The Worldwaker, a planeswalker who helped retake Sea Gate and raised the hedrons.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who aligned the hedrons to bind Ulamog.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City on Tazeem that fell to the Eldrazi and was retaken.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group formed after the catastrophic turn.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's natural upheaval, used as a defense.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas manipulates events that release the Eldrazi in 4557 AR.
events.quote: until Nicol Bolas manipulated events leading to the release of the Eldrazi in 4557 AR

events.summary: Regions including Sejiri, Bala Ged, Oran-Rief and Sea Gate fall to the titans.
events.quote: fell to the titans and their spawn

events.summary: Gideon Jura rallies survivors and allies, who retake Sea Gate with Nissa's help.
events.quote: Together, they recaptured Sea Gate with the help of the Worldwaker Nissa Revane .

events.summary: Nissa raises sunken hedrons and Jace aligns them to bind Ulamog.
events.quote: Nissa raised massive sunken hedrons, which Jace Beleren magically aligned to bind the titan.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis betrays the defenders, destroys the hedron ring and unleashes Kozilek.
events.quote: then unleashed Kozilek from his ancient slumber

relations.note: Imprisoned them thousands of years prior.
relations.quote: The imprisonment of the Eldrazi by the planeswalkers Ugin , Sorin Markov , and Nahiri
Zendikar’s survivors rallied under Gideon Jura
